kind: bounded direct grid-array construction CPU/allocation/native-process-RSS diagnostic
methodology: Identical release probe/lock in separate baseline/candidate and timing/allocation targets. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice, four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case; separate allocation builds. Checked CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID. No task-owned builds/checks/tests ran during timing. Three constructors at 16/48/96 cubed; source-coordinate setup excluded. Curvilinear input Vec clone is staged before the clock/probe, but consuming/converting it and cell construction are timed. Output validation, ordered f64-bit/type/offset/index hash, checks and destruction are outside timing. 3D outputs and array payload lengths must match exactly. Six lower-dimensional affine cases now add real quad/line cells where baseline returns none, so they are correctness-cost references rather than equivalent-work performance comparisons. Payload counts array elements, excluding capacity/metadata/identifiers/fields and allocator overhead. Allocation bytes include positive realloc growth; do not measure peak/live memory. Separate allocator-disabled native process RSS samples use macOS time -l, ABBA twice per constructor at 96 cubed, one fresh process/construction per sample. They include runtime/allocator, coordinate generation and validation/hash work; no curvilinear template clone is retained. RSS is process maximum, not the planned constructor element-workspace budget, VRAM or mobile memory. Thermal/affinity uncontrolled; no measured energy or whole-application claim.
